sections.lecture_material: Microbial experimental advantages, frozen ancestral archives, finite batch resources, optical measurement and diluted colony counts.
sections.research_extension: Stevenson2016 Results/Methods: morphology and growth condition change OD/count calibration.
sections.teaching_construction: CFU dilution equation, measurement distinctions and sampling uncertainty.
sections.evidence_class: lecture exposition with independently derived mathematics; see private coverage ledger

sections.section: Growth phases are different components of performance
sections.lecture_material: Lag, exponential, stationary and death phases; lactose adaptation, physiological history and genotype; no single curve feature resolves every competition.
sections.research_extension: No external empirical claim in this section.
sections.teaching_construction: Fixed-lag piecewise exponential teaching model and explicit phase limitations.
sections.evidence_class: lecture exposition with independently derived mathematics; see private coverage ledger

sections.section: Exponential growth and the doubling-time conversion
sections.lecture_material: Proportional growth ODE, integration, twenty-minute doubling extrapolation and idealised cell geometry.
sections.research_extension: No external empirical claim in this section.
sections.teaching_construction: Derivation, correct natural-log doubling conversion, mass arithmetic and approximation limits.
sections.evidence_class: lecture exposition with independently derived mathematics; see private coverage ledger

sections.section: Logistic growth: a finite capacity and its exact consequences
sections.lecture_material: Logistic growth, environment-dependent capacity, low-density approximation, half-capacity and saturation.
sections.research_extension: No external empirical claim in this section.
sections.teaching_construction: Exact solution, maximum absolute growth, instantaneous versus global rate and undefined K=0 correction.
sections.evidence_class: lecture exposition with independently derived mathematics; see private coverage ledger

sections.section: Two strains compete for one capacity

sections.research_extension: No external empirical claim in this section.

sections.lecture_material: Assay endpoint and growth phases can change which strain has a relative advantage.
